answer.rationale: Write p99 began climbing ~30 minutes after the deploy. Writes already concentrate on the primary, so regional confinement is expected for a write-path regression and does not uniquely diagnose infra failure. Failover at settlement peak could land the same build plus peak write load in the other region and spend the only window. Rollback previously restored a stable prior build without dropping customer writes. Circuit breaking would shed writes and violates the objective; read-replica routing and extra capacity do not address a suspected write-path build defect. Full rollback is the single intervention that best preserves sustained write availability, while leaving open that load or region could still be contributory.
